pairs: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen:
The Lord also said to Moses:
Præcipe filiis Israël,
“Instruct the sons of Israel,
et dices ad eos:
and you shall say to them:
Oblationem meam
Offer my oblation and bread,
et panes,
and the incense of most sweet odor,
et incensum odoris suavissimi offerte per tempora sua.
at their proper times.
Hæc sunt sacrificia quæ offerre debetis:
These are the sacrifices which you must offer:
agnos anniculos immaculatos duos quotidie in holocaustum sempiternum:
Two immaculate one-year-old lambs each day as a perpetual holocaust.
unum offeretis mane,
You shall offer one in morning,
et alterum ad vesperum:
and the other in the evening,
decimam partem ephi similæ,
and the tenth part of an ephah of fine wheat flour,
quæ conspersa sit oleo purissimo,
which has been sprinkled with the purest oil,
et habeat quartam partem hin.
and which has the measure of the fourth part of a hin.
Holocaustum juge est quod obtulistis in monte Sinai in odorem suavissimum incensi Domini.
It is the continual holocaust which you offered at mount Sinai as a most sweet odor of incense to the Lord.
Et libabitis vini quartam partem hin per agnos singulos in sanctuario Domini.
And you shall offer a libation of wine, of the fourth part of a hin for each lamb, in the Sanctuary of the Lord.
Alterumque agnum similiter offeretis ad vesperam juxta omnem ritum sacrificii matutini, et libamentorum ejus, oblationem suavissimi odoris Domino.
And you shall offer the other lamb similarly, in the evening, according to all the rites of the morning sacrifice and its libations, as an oblation of most sweet odor to the Lord.
Die autem sabbati offeretis duos agnos anniculos immaculatos,
Then, on the Sabbath day, you shall offer two immaculate one-year-old lambs,
et duas decimas similæ oleo conspersæ in sacrificio,
and two tenths of fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil, as sacrifice,
et liba:
as well as the libations
quæ rite funduntur per singula sabbata in holocaustum sempiternum.
that are usually poured out on each Sabbath as a perpetual holocaust.
In calendis autem offeretis holocaustum Domino,
Then, on the first day of the month, you shall offer a holocaust to the Lord:
vitulos de armento duos,
two calves from the herd,
arietem unum, agnos anniculos septem immaculatos,
one ram, seven immaculate one-year-old lambs,
et tres decimas similæ oleo conspersæ in sacrificio per singulos vitulos:
and three tenths of fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil, as sacrifice, for each calf,
et duas decimas similæ oleo conspersæ per singulos arietes:
and two tenths of fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil, for each ram,
et decimam decimæ similæ ex oleo in sacrificio per agnos singulos:
and one tenth of fine wheat flour with oil, as a sacrifice, for each lamb.
holocaustum suavissimi odoris atque incensi est Domino.
It is a holocaust of most sweet odor and also an incense to the Lord.
Libamenta autem vini, quæ per singulas fundenda sunt victimas,
Now these shall be the libations of wine, which are to be poured out for each victim:
ista erunt: media pars hin per singulos vitulos,
one half portion of a hin for each calf,
tertia per arietem, quarta per agnum.
one third for a ram, and one fourth for a lamb.
Hoc erit holocaustum per omnes menses,
This shall be the holocaust for all the months,
qui sibi anno vertente succedunt.
as they succeed one another in the turning of the year.
Hircus quoque offeretur Domino pro peccatis in holocaustum sempiternum cum libamentis suis.
Likewise, a he-goat shall be offered to the Lord for sin, with the perpetual holocaust and its libations.
Mense autem primo,
Then,
quartadecima die mensis,
in the first month,
Phase Domini erit,
the fourteenth day of the month shall be the Passover of the Lord.
et quintadecima die solemnitas:
And the fifteenth day shall be a solemnity.
septem diebus vescentur azymis.
For seven days, they shall eat unleavened bread.
Quarum dies prima venerabilis et sancta erit:
And the first day of these days shall be venerable and holy;
omne opus servile non facietis in ea.
you shall not do any servile work in it.
Offeretisque incensum holocaustum Domino,
And you shall offer the incense of a holocaust to the Lord,
vitulos de armento duos,
two calves from the herd,
arietem unum,
one ram,
agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:
seven immaculate one-year-old lambs;
et sacrificia singulorum ex simila quæ conspersa sit oleo,
and with each sacrifice, from fine wheat flour which has been sprinkled with oil,
tres decimas per singulos vitulos,
three tenths for each calf,
et duas decimas per arietem,
and two tenths for each ram,
et decimam decimæ per agnos singulos,
and one tenth for each lamb,
id est,
that is,
per septem agnos.
for the seven lambs;
Et hircum pro peccato unum,
and one he-goat for sin,
ut expietur pro vobis,
as an expiation for you,
præter holocaustum matutinum,
aside from the morning holocaust,
quod semper offeretis.
which you shall always offer.
Ita facietis per singulos dies septem dierum in fomitem ignis,
You shall do this on each day of the seven days,
et in odorem suavissimum Domino,
as fuel for the fire,
qui surget de holocausto,
and as a most sweet odor to the Lord,
et de libationibus singulorum.
which shall rise up from the holocaust and from each of the libations.
Dies quoque septimus celeberrimus et sanctus erit vobis:
Likewise, the seventh day shall be very honored and holy for you.
omne opus servile non facietis in eo.
Any servile work, you shall not do in it.
Dies etiam primitivorum,
And also the day of the first-fruits,
quando offeretis novas fruges Domino,
after the weeks have been fulfilled,
expletis hebdomadibus,
when you shall offer new fruits to the Lord,
venerabilis et sancta erit:
shall be venerable and holy.
omne opus servile non facietis in ea.
You shall not do any servile work in it.
Offeretisque holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino,
And you shall offer a holocaust as a most sweet odor to the Lord:
vitulos de armento duos,
two calves from the herd,
arietem unum,
one ram,
et agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:
and seven immaculate one-year-old lambs,
atque in sacrificiis eorum,
and also, as their sacrifices,
similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per singulos vitulos,
fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil, three tenths for each calf,
per arietes duas,
two for each ram,
per agnos decimam decimæ,
one tenth for each lamb,
qui simul sunt agni septem.
which all together are seven lambs;
Hircum quoque,
likewise, a he-goat,
qui mactatur pro expiatione:
which is slain for expiation,
præter holocaustum sempiternum et liba ejus.
aside from the perpetual holocaust and its libations.
Immaculata offeretis omnia cum libationibus suis.
You shall offer only what is immaculate, with their libations.”
